name: Muslim Legal Fund of America
mission: MLFA is a community-centric grassroots non-profit organization fighting for national security reform, upholding and establishing justice in our courtrooms and communities for Muslims in America. MLFA is the leading nonprofit legal fund dedicated to defending Muslims’ civil rights and liberties at the federal level.
theoryOfChange: MLFA serves to protect and defend the rights of the American Muslim community and others facing discrimination by engaging in litigation, national security injunctions, and nonprofit legal screenings and consultations. Through litigating cases, MLFA aims to set legal precedent and create 'good law.'

strengths_deep_dive: MLFA demonstrates a unique operational capability by providing specialized legal representation in federal criminal defense and civil rights litigation. Its long-standing presence since 2001 allows it to address systemic legal challenges facing American Muslim institutions, offering both direct defense and proactive compliance training for non-profits.
rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 2001, the Muslim Legal Fund of America (MLFA) defends the constitutional rights of American Muslims through legal defense, civil litigation, and nonprofit capacity building. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="5">Total Revenue of $4,046,006</cite> to support its legal programs. MLFA holds an <cite id="1">overall score of 93.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite> and maintains a <cite id="1">Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid</cite>. Operating in a specialized advocacy space, MLFA handles complex criminal defense and civil rights matters, reporting <cite id="6">220 total intake cases across departments in 2022</cite> alongside <cite id="6">training 505 nonprofit leaders and lawyers</cite>. With a <cite id="5">program expense ratio of 71.4%</cite>, MLFA sits below the 75% industry standard, but maintains high financial stability with <cite id="1">5.3 months of operating reserves in working capital</cite>. As a <cite id="2">ZAKAT-ELIGIBLE charity</cite>, MLFA channels funds to legal defense for qualified individuals under established Islamic jurisprudence guidelines.
